similarityNote: Mobile-native structure aligned with paosgi mobile UX (per user-shared screenshot of paosgi at iPhone DevTools emulation). Layout patterns are universal mobile gambling/lottery genre conventions. All visual content (coin medallion / K-Q-J card fan / slot reels '777' / soccer star / fish outline) is original SVG drawn from scratch — no paosgi-specific creative content reproduced.
